artifact:
Feature: Lab Request and Report Management

  Scenario: Lab Request Routing
    Given a patient with a valid pincode
    When a lab request is made with the patient's pincode
    Then the lab request is routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario: Lab Personnel Appointment and Home Collection
    Given a lab personnel with a valid account
    When a patient requests a lab test
    Then the lab personnel makes an appointment and performs home collection of specimen

  Scenario: Offline Reporting and Email/SMS Notification
    Given a lab test result
    When the result is sent to the patient offline
    Then the patient receives an email or SMS notification with the result

  Scenario: Patient Report Upload
    Given a patient with a valid account
    When the patient uploads a report for a consultation
    Then the patient can upload up to 5 reports per consultation, each up to 1 MB in size

  Scenario: Doctor Routing and Consultation
    Given a patient with a valid account and a doctor of a specialty
    When a patient requests a consultation with the doctor
    Then the consultation request is routed to the doctor

  Scenario: Machine Learning Algorithm for Disease Prediction
    Given a patient with symptoms
    When the machine learning algorithm is used to predict diseases
    Then the algorithm provides a predicted diagnosis to the doctor

  Scenario: Doctor Acceptance and Modification of Diagnosis
    Given a doctor with a valid account and a patient with a diagnosis
    When the doctor accepts or modifies the diagnosis
    Then the doctor's changes are reflected in the patient's record

  Scenario: Doctor Responsibility for Diagnosis
    Given a patient with a diagnosis
    When the doctor is responsible for performing the diagnosis
    Then the doctor's diagnosis is the final diagnosis for the patient

  Scenario Outline: Lab Request and Report Management Edge Cases
    Given a patient with a valid pincode
    When a lab request is made with the patient's pincode
    Then the lab request is routed to the Laboratory
    Examples:
      | pincode | result |
      | valid   | routed |
      | invalid | error  |
      | empty   | error  |
